items.exampleEn: Her dress was finely made, with tiny flowers sewn by hand.
items.exampleZh: 她的洋裝做工精細，上面有手工縫的小花。

items.exampleEn: The plants are growing nicely in the new pots.
items.exampleZh: 那些植物在新盆子裡長得很好。

items.exampleEn: Getting a library card is straightforward.
Climbing that mountain in winter is a formidable task.
items.exampleZh: 冬天爬那座山是一項艱鉅的任務。

items.exampleEn: Her speech was a potent reminder of how much teachers matter.
items.exampleZh: 她的演講有力地提醒大家老師有多重要。

items.exampleEn: Our dog's ears stay erect when it hears a strange sound.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的狗聽到奇怪的聲音時，耳朵會豎起來。

items.exampleEn: Her job is varied, so she never gets bored.
items.exampleZh: 她的工作內容很多樣，所以她從不覺得無聊。

items.exampleEn: This question is tricky, so read it twice.
items.exampleZh: 這一題很棘手，所以要讀兩次。

items.sentenceEn: This cheese has a potent smell, so keep it in a closed box.
items.sentenceZh: 這種起司的味道很重，所以要放在密封的盒子裡。

items.audioEn: The recipe is straightforward, and you can buy everything at a small shop.
items.audioZh: 這份食譜很簡單，所有材料在小店就買得到。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得這份食譜怎麼樣？
options: Simple, and the food is easy to get
Hard to make without a big shop

items.sentenceEn: The menu is quite varied, with dishes from many countries.
items.sentenceZh: 菜單相當多樣，有來自許多國家的菜。

items.sentenceEn: The baby giraffe stood erect only an hour after it was born.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻小長頸鹿出生才一個小時就站直了。

items.stemEn: Chop the garlic ____ so that it mixes well with the sauce.
items.stemZh: 把大蒜切細，這樣才能和醬汁拌勻。

items.stemEn: Parking a big car in this narrow street can be ____.
items.stemZh: 在這條窄街停一輛大車可能很棘手。

items.passageEn: Last month, my sister took part in her first chess tournament. The rules were straightforward, but the games were tricky, especially against players with years of experience. In the final, she faced a formidable opponent who had won the tournament three times. She sat erect in her chair and thought carefully about every move, like a painter adding small details. The match lasted four hours, and she persisted even when she was tired. In the end, she lost, but she played well, thanked her opponent nicely, and the crowd clapped for her. Her coach says her style is varied, which makes her hard to predict.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我姊姊參加了她的第一場西洋棋比賽。規則很簡單，但對局很棘手，尤其是遇到經驗豐富的棋手時。決賽中，她碰上一位很難對付的對手，對方已經贏過三次冠軍。她在椅子上坐得挺直，仔細思考每一步，就像畫家在畫小細節。比賽持續了四個小時，她即使累了也堅持下去。最後她輸了，但她下得很好，還很有禮貌地向對手道謝，觀眾都為她鼓掌。她的教練說她的棋風多變，讓人很難預測。

questions.questionZh: 決賽的對手是什麼樣的人？
options: 已經贏過三次冠軍的強手
比賽因為停電延到隔天
她贏了並拿到第一名獎金

items.promptZh: 這件襯衫你穿起來很合身。
referenceEn: This shirt fits you really nicely.
The shirt fits you very nicely.
rubricZh: 「很合身」可寫，例如 fits you nicely、fits you well 等
主詞與動詞一致（例如 fits 等）

items.promptZh: 我的老闆很直率，總是直接說出她的想法。
referenceEn: My boss is very straightforward and always says what she thinks.
My boss is straightforward; she always tells us exactly what she thinks.
rubricZh: straightforward 在這裡指「直率的」（例如 is very straightforward 等）
「說出她的想法」可寫，例如 says what she thinks、tells us what she thinks 等
